Symbolic AST Analyzer for deterministic static inspection of Python code.
Extracts structural invariants, complexity metrics, and flaggable anti-patterns.

nodes.label: CodeAuditCache
nodes.docstring:
Deterministic AST-Hash Semantic Cache.
Prevents redundant LLM API calls by hashing code structure and AST metrics.
Saves 100% of token costs on identical or structurally duplicate submissions.

nodes.label: CodeAuditCache._compute_hash()
nodes.docstring: Computes SHA-256 fingerprint from stripped code and model identifier.

nodes.label: CodeAuditCache._load_disk_cache()
nodes.docstring: Loads cached responses from persistent disk storage.

nodes.label: CodeAuditCache._save_disk_cache()
nodes.docstring: Persists cache to disk.

nodes.label: CodeAuditCache.get()
nodes.docstring: Retrieves cached result if present.

nodes.label: CodeAuditCache.put()
nodes.docstring: Caches audit results keyed by code hash.

nodes.label: src/gateway.py
nodes.docstring:
Enterprise LLM Gateway for CogniCode
====================================
Provides unified routing, automatic failover (OpenAI -> Groq),
latency telemetry, and circuit-breaking for multi-provider resilience.

nodes.label: LLMGateway
nodes.docstring:
Enterprise LLM Gateway:
- Primary Route: OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini)
- Failover Route: Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b)
- Telemetry: tracks requests, latencies, tokens, and failover counts.

nodes.label: LLMGateway.get_resilient_llm()
nodes.docstring: Returns primary LLM, or fails over to secondary provider if primary key is missing.

nodes.label: LLMGateway.invoke_with_failover()
nodes.docstring: Executes an LLM chain with automated failover and telemetry logging.

nodes.label: LLMGateway.get_gateway_health()
nodes.docstring: Returns runtime gateway health and observability metrics.

nodes.label: src/jev_client.py
nodes.docstring:
TypeSafe AI Jev Client
======================
Integrates Jev ("System One" decision model by TypeSafe AI) into CogniCode.
Provides sub-second, typed, and calibrated evaluations (Noul, Choice, Score)
to triage code before or alongside heavier generative LLMs (System Two).

nodes.label: TypeSafeJevClient
nodes.docstring:
Client for TypeSafe AI's Jev model (jev-latest).
Implements System-One fast classification, risk scoring, and boolean gates.

nodes.label: TypeSafeJevClient.triage_code()
nodes.docstring:
Executes System-One evaluation questions across security, complexity, and risk.
Returns typed answers with confidence distributions and latency metrics.

nodes.label: TypeSafeJevClient._local_calibrated_triage()
nodes.docstring:
Deterministic, fast System-One evaluator simulating Jev's typed question rubric.
Ensures zero pipeline disruption if user hasn't set an API key.

nodes.label: EpisodicMemoryBank
nodes.docstring:
Episodic Bug Memory Bank using semantic scoring over verified enterprise CWE patterns.
Provides few-shot in-context learning to guide the LLM patch synthesizer.

nodes.label: EpisodicMemoryBank.retrieve_relevant_patterns()
nodes.docstring:
Retrieves the top-k most relevant vulnerability remediation templates
based on token and keyword overlap.

nodes.label: retrieve_memory_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 1: Retrieves matching CWE/OWASP enterprise patterns from Episodic Memory Bank.

nodes.label: symbolic_ast_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 2: Performs deterministic symbolic AST static parsing, TypeSafe Jev triage & checks semantic cache.

nodes.label: security_audit_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 3: Specialized Security Auditor analyzes vulnerabilities and maps to CWE.

nodes.label: complexity_profiler_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 4: Big-O Algorithmic Performance Engineer evaluates time and space complexity.

nodes.label: patch_synthesizer_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 5: Synthesizes refactored code and comprehensive Pytest test suite.

nodes.label: sandbox_verifier_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 6: Executes Pytest in isolated subprocess sandbox with wall-clock timeout.

nodes.label: self_healing_reflection_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 7: Reflects on Pytest failure trace and autonomously repairs code & tests.

nodes.label: git_pr_node()
nodes.docstring: Node 8: Generates unified git diff, branch name, and institutional PR description.

nodes.label: run_test_in_sandbox()
nodes.docstring:
Executes pytest against the candidate code in an isolated temporary directory.
Enforces process timeouts and captures full stdout/stderr and failure traces.

nodes.label: AgentState
nodes.docstring:
Unified typed state contract for the CogniCode multi-agent graph.
Acts as the Single Source of Truth passed across all LangGraph nodes.

CogniCode Engine
Autonomous Multi-Agent Code Remediation & Test-Driven Self-Healing Engine.

nodes.label: compute_nth_fibonacci()
nodes.docstring:
Computes the N-th Fibonacci number.
PERFORMANCE BOTTLENECK: Naive binary recursion produces O(2^N) exponential time complexity,
leading to severe CPU starvation and stack overflow on N >= 35 (CWE-400).

nodes.label: extract_user_contact_info()
nodes.docstring:
Extracts secondary email from a nested user profile payload.
VULNERABILITY: Blind chained dereference without null-checks causes fatal NoneType crash (CWE-476).

nodes.label: authenticate_user()
nodes.docstring:
Authenticates a user against an SQLite database.
VULNERABILITY: Direct string formatting into raw SQL enables SQL Injection (CWE-89).
